integrity: Original analytic proof accompanied by finite exact-arithmetic checks; no independent audit or validation claimed. Originality comparison is bounded; De Michele–Figà-Talamanca (1980) could not be inspected materially.
scientific_limitations: All parameters are proved on homogeneous trees of finite degree at least three; homogeneous paths and the isolated singular boundary are treated explicitly. No assertion is made for arbitrary trees or more general radial profiles.
title: Two resonance bands and a sharp damping threshold for oscillatory covariances on regular trees
